verdict.rationale: The docs say budgets can cap spend per API key, and API keys are a first-party, team-owned credential. So an agent can be given its own key with a spend cap. Nothing in the evidence shows rate-limit guardrails on a key, and budget enforcement behavior is covered only by one-line mentions. Missing for 10: per-key rate limiting, detailed docs on budget enforcement (hard stop vs alert, reset periods), independent or hands-on confirmation that the caps stop runaway agent spend.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: To cap how much your team, a project, an API key, or a team member can spend, set [budgets]
